videos.title: C01｜定義系統任務與封裝需求｜Define system and package requirements｜5分鐘 / 5 min
videos.description:
以假設的加速器建立可追溯需求表，從工作負載走到頻寬、散熱、外形與測試條件。所有數值都是教學假設，不是產品規格或量測結果。
Build traceable requirements for a hypothetical accelerator, connecting workload to bandwidth, cooling, envelope and test conditions. Every numerical value is an educational assumption, not a product specification or measured result.

學習重點 / Learning objectives
交付含需求 ID、單位、條件、責任人、驗證方法與版本的需求基線；分清原始線速與有效資料率、整體熱預算與局部熱點，並用失效情境檢查未決事項。
Deliver a requirements baseline with IDs, units, conditions, owners, verification methods and revisions. Distinguish raw line rate from useful throughput and system heat budgets from local hot spots; challenge unresolved assumptions with a failure case.

本片為三維工程教學重建，不是廠房實拍、原廠 CAD 或量測模擬；圖中比例、顏色與動態用於解說，不代表製程尺寸、實測溫度、速度、良率或壽命。
An educational 3D reconstruction, not factory footage, vendor CAD or a measurement-based simulation. Visual scale, color and motion explain concepts; they do not establish manufacturing dimensions, measured temperatures, speeds, yields or lifetime.

交付 MP4 含繁中、英文、日文、韓文與簡中五語合成旁白；預設繁中。字幕以本語實際語音時間配對英文，英文軌為單語。YouTube 可選語音與字幕以播放器已發布的選單為準。
The delivery MP4 contains synthetic narration in Traditional Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean and Simplified Chinese; Traditional Chinese is the default. Native-language captions follow measured speech with a corresponding English line; the English track is English-only. Available YouTube audio and caption languages depend on the tracks published in its player.

sources.title: 3D-IC Design Challenges and Requirements
sources.supports: Early system intent, cross-domain co-design, power/thermal planning and test access. The numerical example, requirement IDs and teaching sequence are original synthesis.

sources.title: Readying the supply chain for chiplets and heterogeneous IC packaging
sources.supports: Heterogeneous integration requires package/design/test infrastructure; silicon interposer, high-density fan-out and bridges are distinct integration alternatives. Cost depends on both silicon and packaging.

sources.title: Stress and Thermal Lab
sources.supports: Package and system thermal analysis, hot spots, transient power, boundary-sensitive thermal measurements and correlated design work. No numeric requirement from this page is reproduced.

sources.title: IC Semiconductor Test Services
sources.supports: Wafer probe, final test and system-level test have distinct infrastructure, electrical/power and performance requirements.

sources.title: Specifications
sources.supports: A die-to-die interface contract includes physical, protocol and compliance/test concerns. The illustrative 64-lane arithmetic is not represented as a compliant UCIe configuration.
